# langsmith_evaluator (Data Source)

Looks up a single LangSmith hosted evaluator by `evaluator_id` (`GET /v1/platform/evaluators/{evaluator_id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) Bogware, Inc. 2025
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "langsmith_evaluator" "existing" {
  evaluator_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}

output "evaluator_name" {
  value = data.langsmith_evaluator.existing.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `evaluator_id` (String) Evaluator ID (OpenAPI path parameter `evaluator_id`).

### Read-Only

- `code_evaluator` (String) JSON-encoded `evaluators.CodeEvaluator` when `type` is `code`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator user ID.
- `feedback_keys` (List of String) Associated feedback keys.
- `id` (String) Same as `evaluator_id` (stable identifier from the API).
- `llm_evaluator` (String) JSON-encoded `evaluators.LLMEvaluator` when `type` is `llm`.
- `name` (String) Evaluator display name.
- `run_rules` (String) JSON-encoded `run_rules` array.
- `tenant_id` (String) Workspace tenant ID.
- `type` (String) `llm` or `code`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
